The owner on the repeat number (ANS-262563_1-1): «اذا 1 قد تم اصداره فيخرج كامل الي الاخير ثم يتبعه 2 حتى الاخير، 3
حتى الاخير هكذا»; «issued» = its model made (entered the line); a notice only when a repeat is cut after an earlier one.
- mdl_intake.in_line(): a superseded repeat with a model written is no longer stopped («… is superseded») at the
  nesting (LEVEL7 and GRAFIS paths): it is cut, with an info line naming the newer repeat. One never made is replaced.
- ui/cad.order_rows: such a repeat is listed; a repeat cut after an earlier repeat of the same order line was cut has
  «repeat … was cut on …» (shown in its details); report.day_report lists them.
